The diver's right hand appears to be merging or blending into the purple fin in the foreground. It is unclear if the hand is holding it or if they are fused together due to generation error.
The fin has a very smooth, plastic-like texture that lacks the typical wear, straps, or foot pocket details seen on real fins. It looks like a generic 3D model.
The left arm (viewer's right) seems to emerge from the BCD in an unnatural way, and the shoulder geometry is slightly distorted.
